title: feat: line-item table cells for people, multi-select, tags, check and rating (#36043)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

Fixes #36043

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTbWpneBrqq7SJvrNt

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no skill names the inline grid column `type` values or keys (`git grep` of `skills/` for `inlineColumns` and the column type list: one passing mention in `objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, which lists no types)

## 维护者速读

- 表单里的明细表（主从表单的行项目表格）中，人员格子可以直接搜索选人，多选格子可以选多个选项，标签格子可以加标签，勾选格子是复选框，评分格子是星星；以前这些都是普通文本框，人员要手填用户编号，多选只能填一个值。
- 属于列表页重做专题的单元格编辑那一组，替在主从表单里录入明细行的用户解决「人员、多选填不进去」的问题。
- 已有表单的明细表会直接变样：布尔字段从「是/否」下拉变成复选框，评分字段从数字框变成星星；作者在列上明确写了类型的不受影响；出错时最坏是这几类格子不好用，已存的数据不受影响，可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

The card's words map onto the enum by the spec's existing rule that every column type is spelled as its namesake field type (the `inline-grid-column-carriers` probe and the `field.json` liveness note rely on it): people = `user`, multi-select = `multiselect`, tags = `tags`, check = `boolean`, rating = `rating`.

**Spec (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`).** `InlineGridColumnSchema.type` gains `user`, `multiselect`, `tags`, `boolean` and `rating` (nine → fourteen). The column gains one optional key, `max`: the star count of a `rating` cell (default 5), because a column carries no field definition and a `max: 10` rating would otherwise draw five stars. `options` and `multiple` describe what the new cells read from them. `inline-grid-columns.ts` (`deriveInlineGridColumns`' cell-type mirror) maps the same way, and each new cell type keeps the fill priority its field types had before, so which derived columns are visible by default does not change (the existing budget pins stay green unchanged). Liveness ledger: the `type` note lists fourteen types, and a `max` child row. Regenerated: reference docs, `authorable-surface/data.json` (one new key), liveness state counts.

**Derivation (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts`).** `fieldTypeToColumnType` maps `user` → `user`, `multiselect` / `checkboxes` → `multiselect`, `tags` → `tags`, `boolean` / `toggle` → `boolean`, `rating` → `rating`. A derived or hydrated column carries `multiple` from a multi-person field, `max` from a rating field, and the child's options on `multiselect` / `tags` columns. A `boolean` column keeps the two options it carried as a select (`'true'` / `'false'`, labelled with the session's words through `booleanLabel`): they are the words its read-only and list-mode cells read as, so `booleanLabel` stays live. A column that declares its `type` is left alone, as before.

**Cells (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`, `gridCellPanels.tsx`).** The cells reuse the main list's in-cell faces rather than forking them:

- `GridPanelCell` (new, beside S5's `GridSelectCell`) is a panel shell under the cell that hosts a widget's own `inCell` face over a draft: a click outside or Tab writes the draft, Esc writes nothing, and a face that ends on one pick calls `commit`. The cell keeps drawing its value while the panel is open.
- `multiselect` hosts `MultiSelectField inCell`, `tags` hosts `TagsField inCell`, and `user` hosts `UserField inCell` (the main list's person picker: searchable list, recents, Clear; a single pick writes and closes).
- `boolean` is the `Checkbox` primitive (click / Space), writing `true` / `false`.
- `rating` draws `RatingField inCell` (a click on a star sets it); a digit key on the cell sets that many stars, 0 clears, a digit above `max` does nothing.
- Read-only table and list mode: people by name (`UserField readonly`), a rating as its stars, a multi-select's option labels, a check cell as its option word (else the session's yes/no word).
- A required cell holding an empty list (multi-select, tags, several people) reads invalid, as an empty scalar does.

Item 2 of the card (interim read-only columns) is not built: the seat reads it as superseded once item 1 ships, and this PR ships item 1.

**Visible change on existing master-detail forms** (named in the changeset): a derived `boolean` / `toggle` column is a checkbox instead of the yes/no select and writes booleans instead of the strings `'true'` / `'false'` (the server's write normalisation reads both the same); a derived `rating` column is stars instead of a number box; `user`, `multiselect`, `checkboxes` and `tags` columns are no longer plain text boxes.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` "the cells that edit as in the main list": multi-select (labels, several picks staged then written on leaving, Esc writes nothing, empty list reads invalid when required), tags (a new tag added from the list, Tab writes and moves to the next cell), check (checkbox over `true` and `'false'`, click writes a boolean, read-only reads the option word), rating (five stars by default, a click sets, digit keys set and 0 clears, a digit above the stars sets nothing, `max: 10` draws ten), people (the person picker opens under the cell; its Clear writes and closes).
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.test.ts`: the five mappings with their neighbours as controls; a new `describe` pinning the extras on both the derive and the hydrate path (`multiple`, options, the check column's two words, `max` from the field and none when the field declares none), and that an authored column, a `type: 'select'` over a boolean field included, keeps its type and extras.
- `deriveMasterDetail.booleanOptions-12924.test.tsx`: the derived boolean column is now `type: 'boolean'` with the same two session-language options; the editable grid pins read checkbox states instead of picker text; the language-switch pin now re-labels the read-only table (the editable check cell shows no word).
- `MasterDetailForm.lateCatalogue-12924.test.tsx`: the late-catalogue re-label is read where the grid still draws a boolean's word, a second detail in `inlineMode: 'form'`; the editable `Lines` detail keeps the unsaved edit and its checkboxes through the catalogue landing.
- `deriveMasterDetail.inlineGridColumns-11345.test.ts`: the "output unchanged" corpus moves its one derived boolean column (`gift`) from `select` to `boolean`, marked where it sits; nothing else in the corpus moves.

## Deviations

Four files outside the claim's surface, each a direct consequence of the widening. Seat 7 counts them inside the card.

- `packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts`: `INLINE_COLUMN_POSITIONS` classifies the new `max` key as `keep` (a number, never a field name). `object-schema-fls-references.test.ts` refuses an unclassified `InlineGridColumnSchema` key, so it was red in Test Core 3/10 at `10767ef3`.
- `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/strict-face-read-keys-11070.test.ts`: the refused-column-type row used `boolean`, which is now a cell type, so it moves to `toggle`, which is still refused. It was red in Test UI 12/16 at `10767ef3`.
- `ui/packages/types/src/form.ts`: a docblock no longer counts "nine" cell controls.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx`: the inline grid bullets list the fourteen cell types and the checkbox booleans, and add the people, multi-select, tags and rating cells.

The changeset adds `'@objectstack/metadata-core': patch` and `'@object-ui/types': patch` for the first two packages.

## Acceptance notes

- A click outside a multi-select / tags / people panel writes through the popover's own dismiss (`onOpenChange`). This test harness's pointer events do not reach that dismiss (a probe with a bare `GridPanelCell` measured it: neither `pointerDown` nor `focusIn` outside closed the popover), so the pins leave the panel through Tab. NOT MEASURED in a browser.
- `rating` cells keep `RatingField`'s one button per star, so Tab visits each star; the arrows and digit keys work from any of them.

## Verification

Measured locally at head `10767ef3` and carried to `ccb079c9` (merge base `482afcc4`; `overlap-check` clean against `origin/main` `ed33f8ae` and the one open PR sharing files, #36351):

- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 118 derived families accounted for, 117 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 because it needs the whole workspace built; left to CI). Three first-pass refusals were cleared and rerun green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone), `check:skill-examples` (`@objectstack/client-react` built), and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (killed for memory when it overlapped a suite, then 172 files / 5,127 tests green on its own).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 871 files, 27,909 tests passed. `test:repo`: 92 files, 1,562 tests passed. `check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date.
- `ui/packages/fields` (whole package): 320 files, 4,840 tests passed. `ui/packages/plugin-form/src` (whole package): 242 of 244 files green, the other two being the pins above, which then moved and pass when rerun on their own (30 tests). `packages/types` parity files (`zod-mirror-parity`, `form-field-zod-coverage`, `grid-field-keys-camelcase-11610`): 110 tests passed.
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-form` (test files included): clean. `pnpm check:error-code-casing`: clean.
- Not measured in a browser: the outside-click write (see Acceptance notes).
- At `ccb079c9`, the 4 files under Deviations: `object-schema-fls-references.test.ts` 63/63, `strict-face-read-keys-11070.test.ts` 94/94, `metadata-core` typecheck clean, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check-affected-docs`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset` exit 0, and `overlap-check` clean.
